title: Austin's New Leaders Emerge from Run-off
summary:
*   The special meeting focused solely on formally certifying the results of the May 26 general municipal run-off election.
*   Michael "Max" Nofzlger was officially declared the winner for City Council Place No. 1.
*   Bob Larson secured the victory for City Council Place No. 4.
*   The entire process was swift, with the meeting concluding in just 15 minutes after affirming the election outcomes.
